verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud data platform, but the pack documents no local engine, emulator, or free sandbox for building transformations. The development surfaces it does document all run on Snowflake-hosted compute: Notebooks in Snowsight, dbt Projects on Snowflake with managed runtimes, and the Snowflake CLI for managing apps on Snowflake. Object cloning and a community free-trial anecdote are adjacent: clones still consume warehouse credits, and a trial is not a documented local or free dev loop.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I get a fast local or free dev loop — a local engine, emulator, or sandbox — to develop transformations before touching production compute
